title: RASTERVARIABLES DWG writer scalar domains
scope: The DWG writer now rejects undocumented display-frame, image-quality and insertion-unit values while the parser continues to preserve source values. The existing class-version range is unchanged because ODA's DWG body specifies a bit-long field but does not define the DXF class-version constant's domain.

implementation.behavior: dwgWriter15::writeRasterVariables refuses classVersion outside 0..10, frame outside 0/1, quality outside 0/1, and units outside 0..8 before common-state preparation, EED processing, handle reservation, or class registration. DRW_RasterVariables::encodeDwg repeats these guards at the body boundary. The parser is unchanged and remains tolerant.

regressionControl.coverage: The generated local DWG roundtrip first submits frame=2, requires refusal, corrects the same RASTERVARIABLES object to frame=1, writes it, and verifies typed readback. It also checks classVersion=11, quality=2 and units=9 refusals. A dedicated selector tests all four invalid dimensions directly through dwgWriter15 with a null backing stream.

validation.owningTestResult: nonzero: 16 ACDS/modeler and DWG read-outcome assertions fail; no RASTERVARIABLES assertion is reported, including the same-writer retry and readback checks
validation.baselineComparison: The same 16 unrelated ACDS/modeler and read-outcome failures were reproduced against HEAD in the prior validation pass.

fixturePolicy.generatedInputs: The local DWG writer harness generates its input; no fixture was added.
